MP-ASH-Viewer 1.1.0: Active Session History for Oracle, including Standard Edition and without the Diagnostics Pack (OracleSE profile).

**Download** `MP-ASH-Viewer-v1.1.0.zip`, unzip it and follow `README.txt` (Java 11+ with graphics, the Oracle JDBC driver in `lib/`, then `exec_ashv.sh` or `exec_ashv.bat`).

New in this version:

- **Now: OS** tab: server CPU (user, sys, I/O wait), load per core, how much of the CPU is this database (or each PDB, when connected to the root), memory (RAM, free, OS cache, swap, SGA, PGA, paging), a chart of the last 60 refreshes and I/O by function with latency. New grants in `ashv-grants.sql` (`v_$osstat`, `v_$sys_time_model`, `v_$sgainfo`, `v_$iostat_function`).
- **DBMS_XPLAN** sub tab in the SQL details (`DBMS_XPLAN.DISPLAY_CURSOR`, with actual rows when available); the plan tree is easier to read and full table scans are highlighted.
- Fixes: Top Activity keeps the last hour after a connection gap (Reconnect); OracleSE is the default profile of a new connection; connection names no longer cut with "..." in the connection tree.

Details: [README](https://github.com/mpontes-stack/MP-ASH-Viewer#readme) and [FEATURES](https://github.com/mpontes-stack/MP-ASH-Viewer/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md).
